name: CGLS Solver (Conjugate Gradient Least Squares)
definition: A sparse linear least squares solver used to avoid the ill-conditioning of normal equations ($A^T A$), providing numerically stable results for large or rank-deficient problems.
summary: The CGLS solver is a sparse linear least squares method that avoids ill-conditioning by using matrix-vector products, providing numerical stability for large or rank-deficient problems.
